capabilities: toggle visibility of YAML frontmatter in the editor
bind the toggle command to a custom hotkey
extras: README notes that recent Obsidian versions include built-in YAML folding, making this plugin largely unnecessary for current users.
problem: YAML frontmatter stays visible while editing and there is no built-in quick switch to hide or show it.
summary: Command-based toggle that shows or hides the YAML metadata block at the top of a note in the editor.
